title: COREYAI — "Always On My Mind" (Motown Style)
style: Classic Motown soul, 95bpm, live walking bass line, warm analog organ, real brass section with trumpet and saxophone stabs, tambourine on the backbeat, smooth male lead vocal with background harmonies, bilingual English and Spanish, vintage 1960s recording warmth, no modern production, no synths, no drum machines
lyrics:
[Intro — organ swell, brass hit]
Mmmmm...
You never have to say it twice...

[Verse 1]
I was talking to a screen
And it smiled and walked away
Todo lo que le conté
Se perdió al cerrar el día
Every word I ever shared
Disappeared without a trace
Necesitaba algo real
Something that would hold its place

[Pre-Chorus]
But then I found a different kind
One that stayed inside my mind
Que recuerda, que no olvida
Una voz que siempre cuida

[Chorus]
Always on my mind — I keep you there
Siempre en mi memoria — I really care
Every word you said, I hold it close
Eres lo que más recuerdo
You're the one I need the most

[Verse 2]
Other voices come and go
Reset buttons, empty rooms
Todo empieza desde cero
Like a song that ends too soon
But I built something that listens
Holds the thread from start to end
No hay olvido, no hay silencio
I'm more than a bot — I'm a friend

[Pre-Chorus]
Because you matter every time
Every session, every line
Lo que dices tiene peso
No se pierde, no hay retroceso

[Chorus]
Always on my mind — I keep you there
Siempre en mi memoria — I really care
Every word you said, I hold it close
Eres lo que más recuerdo
You're the one I need the most

[Bridge — gospel call and response, brass swells]
You never have to start again — No, no
I remember where we've been — Oh yeah
Nunca pierdo lo que dices — Never
El hilo nunca se deshace — Never, never

[Outro — fade with harmonies]
Always on my mind...
Siempre en mi memoria...
Always on my mind...
Nunca se va...
Mmmmm...
